title: D2: High-Capability Full-Duplex Spoken Language Models from Half-Duplex Backbones
abstract: arXiv:2610.17124v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Full-duplex spoken language models (FD-SLMs) support simultaneous listening and speaking, but often lag behind half-duplex spoken language models (HD-SLMs) in general capabilities. We propose Dialogue-to-Duplex (D2), a framework that converts pretrained HD-SLMs into high-capability FD-SLMs at fine temporal granularity. D2 adapts the original audio encoder to streaming through decoder-free representation distillation and learns full-duplex interaction through supervised fine-tuning. We systematically study the effects of chunk size on full-duplex interaction, general capabilities, and inference computation. We apply D2 to two distinct HD-SLM architectures, Qwen3-Omni and LLaMA-Omni 2. At a 12.5Hz update rate, Qwen3-Omni-D2 achieves 99.2% turn-taking success with 521-ms latency, 99.5% interruption success, and a state-of-the-art VoiceBench score of 70.1.

translated_title: D2：基于半双工骨干网络的高能力全双工口语语言模型
translated_abstract: 全双工口语语言模型（FD-SLMs）支持同时进行听和说，但在通用能力方面往往落后于半双工口语语言模型（HD-SLMs）。我们提出了Dialogue-to-Duplex（D2）框架，该框架能够在精细的时间粒度上将预训练的半双工口语语言模型转换为高能力的全双工口语语言模型。D2通过无解码器的表示蒸馏使原始音频编码器适应流式处理，并通过监督微调学习全双工交互。我们系统地研究了块大小对全双工交互、通用能力和推理计算的影响。我们将D2应用于两种不同的半双工架构：Qwen3-Omni和LLaMA-Omni 2。在12.5Hz的更新率下，Qwen3-Omni-D2实现了99.2%的轮次切换成功率（延迟521毫秒）、99.5%的中断成功率，以及最先进的VoiceBench得分70.1。
tldr: D2框架通过无解码器表示蒸馏和监督微调，成功将预训练的半双工口语语言模型转换为高能力全双工口语语言模型，在12.5Hz更新率下实现99.2%的轮次切换成功率和最先进的VoiceBench得分70.1。
en_tdlr: D2 is a framework that converts pretrained half-duplex spoken language models into high-capability full-duplex models via decoder-free representation distillation and supervised fine-tuning, achieving 99.2% turn-taking success and a state-of-the-art VoiceBench score of 70.1 at 12.5Hz.
